name: Bermondsey Beer Tasting Tour
schedule: Usually Saturdays at 1:00pm and 5:00pm (various days and times available)
meeting_point: Southwark Brewing, 46 Druid St, London SE1 2EZ
summary: A guided walking tour of the best breweries and taprooms on Bermondsey's famous 'beer mile', led by accredited Beer Sommelier and Certified Cicerone Paul Davies, with tutored tastings at 4 tap rooms.
description_md:
London has a fantastic craft beer scene with over 130 breweries based in the city. Our Bermondsey beer tour will include the best breweries and taprooms of the city's famous 'beer mile'. Groups of up to 20 will be personally guided by beer expert Paul Davies to 4 tap rooms enabling the inquisitive traveller to easily engage with my city's craft beer scene.

An accredited Beer Sommelier and Certified Cicerone® Paul will give you a tutored beer tasting where you will discover how sensory analysts and beer judges evaluate the qualities and styles characteristics in a glass of beer. You will also come away with knowledge of the beer styles that you are tasting, their history and evolution. This is a step up from a traditional tasting tour and elevates beer tasting experiences to another level.
includes: Personal guidance from beer expert Paul Davies
Knowledge of beer styles, history, and evolution

name: Bermondsey Cheese Meat & Beer Tour
meeting_point: Southwark Brewery, 46 Druid Street, London SE1 2EZ
summary: A guided food and beer pairing tour through 4 Bermondsey brewery taprooms, combining beer tastings with cheese and cured meat pairings explained by your guide.
description_md: What could be better than cheese, meat and beer all together (I'm sure vegetarian's may differ). This tour takes place inside 4 different Bermondsey brewery taprooms and you'll enjoy beers at each stop. We meet in Southwark Brewery for a welcome drink and introduction, before heading down to Billy Frank's Jerky for cheese and beer tastings. We'll then walk the short trip down to Anspach & Hobday or Bianca Road or Moor Vaults. Your guide will be on hand to talk you through the food and drink sampled and explain how different foods and flavours pair well to different styles of beer.

name: Bermondsey Microbrewery Experience
schedule: Most Saturdays at 12 midday (check availability for specific dates)
meeting_point: Southwark Brewery, 46 Druid Street, London SE1 2EZ
summary: London's flagship in-depth beer discovery walking tour of the famous Bermondsey Beer Mile, visiting at least four microbreweries with behind-the-scenes access and tastings. Currently postponed following the death of guide Des de Moor.
description_md:
London's flagship in-depth beer discovery walking tour based on the famous Bermondsey Beer Mile, running in the historic brewing heartlands of London since 2014. The tour visits a selection of the best local microbreweries in the area on a walking tour.

Led by expert guide Des de Moor (author of *London's Best Beer, Pubs and Bars*), participants discover Bermondsey's craft beer scene and brewing history, hear about the Kernel Brewery's 2009 launch that sparked the craft beer boom, and walk approximately 1.6 miles visiting at least four breweries. Go behind the scenes to discover what goes into making great beer, as explained by our expert guide and the brewers themselves.

The tour features tastings of different beer styles in characteristic railway arch taprooms, offering a varied experience from traditional cask beer to cutting edge contemporary craft beer. Current stops include Southwark Brewery and Partizan.

*Note from the page: "Due to the sad death of our fantastic guide Des De Moor – this tour is currently postponed."*

name: Bristol Craft Beer Experience
schedule: Saturdays (check availability for starting times and dates)
meeting_point: Outside Grain Barge, Hotwell Rd, Bristol BS8 4RU
summary: A Bristol beer tour combining a private 30-minute harbour ferry cruise with tastings, a behind-the-scenes visit to Moor Brewery, and a finish at The Beer Emporium with beers and cheese and meat platters.
description_md:
The tour begins by meeting outside Grain Barge and heading to the ferry for a private 30-minute harbour tour. Enjoy a talk and tasting of 2 local beer styles while sailing past the old Bristol brewery site, learning about the city's brewing history.

The group then visits Moor Brewery for a behind-the-scenes look at the brewing equipment and a discussion with the team on beer production, followed by tastings in the taproom.

An approximately 20-minute walk through Castle Park leads past the old Bristol Brewery site, then on to The Beer Emporium on King Street for final tastings and shared cheese and meat platters (nibbles rather than a full meal, though pizza discounts are available).

name: Lewes Brewery Tours
summary: A monthly guided beer tour of Lewes, East Sussex, visiting Harvey's Brewery, Abyss Brewing Co. and Beak Brewery with tastings, led by Certified Cicerone and International Beer Judge Dan of That's The Beer Talking.
description_md:
Enjoy a brewery tour and tasting in Lewes.

Lewes is a charming town located in East Sussex, England. It is known for its picturesque streets, historic landmarks, and cultural significance. The town is surrounded by the South Downs National Park, which provides a stunning backdrop for outdoor activities such as hiking and cycling. Lewes is also home to some of the finest breweries in the country, where visitors can learn about the brewing process, sample some delicious beers, and immerse themselves in the town's rich brewing heritage. Whether you're a history buff, an outdoor enthusiast, or a beer lover, Lewes has something to offer for everyone.

That's The Beer Talking is founded by Dan, who's a Certified Cicerone & International Beer Judge, and will be on hand to tell you everything about Lewes & Beer that you never knew you needed to know, while drinking a variety of the freshest, hand picked beers we can get our hands on.

Visit Harvey's Brewery, Abyss Brewing Co. & Beak Brewery on this monthly beer tour with tastings included.
includes: Guide commentary on Lewes and beer history

name: Liverpool Craft Beer Tour
meeting_point: Inside The Ship & Mitre pub, Liverpool
summary: A 4-hour walking tour of Liverpool's craft beer scene visiting two microbreweries and two award-winning beer pubs, with behind-the-scenes access, brewer meet-and-greets and beer tastings.
description_md:
Discover Liverpool's booming craft beer scene and meet its heroes on our Liverpool Craft Beer Experience. This walking tour will take you on an exclusive behind the scenes journey to some of Liverpool's most exciting breweries and taprooms.

Join us on a Liverpool Craft Beer Tour to go behind the scenes, meet the brewers, and taste their beers! We'll experience two microbreweries and two award-winning beer-based pubs on our journey. Learn about beer ingredients and how the beer is made into different styles using different techniques and expert craftsmanship. With plenty to discover, the Liverpool Craft Beer Experience will leave you spoilt for choice.
includes: Guided tasting experience by a Beer Expert
Multiple beer tastings across various styles

name: Manchester Microbrewery Experience
summary: A guided craft beer walking tour of Manchester's hidden craft beer gems, with brewery taproom visits, diverse beer style tastings hand-picked by local guides, and a group size limited to 25.
description_md:
During this Manchester Craft Beer Experience, you will visit several hidden craft beer gems that you might not have discovered otherwise. Each venue offers a unique atmosphere, and you'll learn all about the brewing process from our knowledgeable local beer guides.

At each stop, you'll have the opportunity to sample a wide variety of beer styles, handpicked by your guide to ensure you get a diverse and exciting tasting experience. From old favorites like IPAs to more unusual and rare beer styles like grisettes and wild-fermented beers, there's something for every palette and level of expertise.

Our group size is limited to 25 people to ensure everyone gets the attention they need and to make the tour more intimate and interactive. The walking distance is approximately 1 mile, so comfortable shoes are recommended.

name: The Leeds Heritage Pub Tour
summary: A three-and-a-half-hour exploration of over 300 years of Leeds pub and brewing history, led by local expert guide Mike, with a half pint included at each historic pub stop from The Tetley to Whitelock's Ale House.
description_md:
Enjoy an exploration of over 300 years of pub and brewing history in Leeds, led by local expert and passionate independent tour guide Mike. Fully self-researched, this three-and-a-half-hour tour brings to life stories of the people, places and events that shaped the city's incredible pub heritage, with drinks included to keep everyone refreshed along the way.

Starting at The Tetley, hear the two-century story of Tetley Brewery, which went on to become one of Yorkshire's most beloved, and Britain's largest. The tour then heads on to the Adelphi, a classic late Victorian pub. Understand how the architecture played an important part of the Victorian pub experience, before watching heritage video artefacts showing what life was like for one of Leeds' breweries in the early and mid-20th century. From here, the group will then head for a walk through Brewery Wharf, stopping at various points of interest on the way. The next stop is the Lamb & Flag, where a fun map reading task will take place, before hearing the history of the building, opened in 1801. Then it's time for another walk, this time to explore some ghost pubs of Leeds – buildings that used to be pubs, with evidence still in the architecture. This leads the group to the White Swan, with a history that ties it closely to neighbouring City Varieties Music Hall. Here, explore a modern map of Leeds City Centre and learn how brewing has evolved in the area. The final tour stop is Whitelock's Ale House, arguably Leeds' jewel in the pub crown. Founded in 1715, the pub boasts a fascinating history which Mike will explain unvarnished to finish the tour.

Throughout the tour, Mike will tell you stories from old local newspapers and books, show and use old maps and images and lots more to bring history to life. At each pub stop, a half pint is included for each guest. Enjoy either hand-pulled ale, draught lager or cider, or a soft drink. For tour timings and guest wellbeing, upgrades to pints or higher alcohol content drinks such as wines and spirits are not offered as part of this tour.

Your guide Mike is Leeds born and bred. He is currently the serving Secretary of the British Guild of Beer Writers and has a background that has seen him operate a micro-brewery, run a pub, organise beer festivals and serve as the Chair for the Leeds branch of the Campaign for Real Ale.
includes: Half pint at each pub stop (hand-pulled ale, draught lager, cider, or soft drink)
Expert-led tour by local guide Mike
Walk through Brewery Wharf and ghost pubs exploration

name: Leeds Craft Beer Experience
schedule: Saturdays at 1:15pm (does not run every weekend; check dates)
meeting_point: Nomadic Beers, Unit 11, Sheepscar House, 15 Sheepscar St N, Leeds LS7 1AD
summary: A 4-hour expert-led walking tour of Leeds' craft beer scene starting with a brewery tour at Nomadic Beers, then Brew York, North Brewing Co and Leeds City Tap, finishing at the iconic Cross Keys.
description_md:
Join us on a 4-hour walking tour discovering the best of Leeds' craft beer scene on an in depth guided tour led by beer experts. Discover a range of beer styles and the story behind them on this expert led tour in Leeds.

Learn how beer is made with stops at Nomadic Beers, Brew York in Leeds, Leeds original Brewpub, North Brewing Co & Leeds City Tap. Finish up at the iconic Cross Keys on this guided beer tasting tour in Leeds.

The day starts inside Nomadic Beers with a brewery tour of the equipment with tastings. Then onto Brew York in Leeds followed by North Brewing Co, Leeds City Tap and a final tasting at the Cross Keys.
includes: Behind-the-scenes brewery tour with equipment viewing
Expert-led guidance on beer styles and production

name: Kent Hop Farm Tour at Hukins Hops
schedule: Tours take place between May and September every year; specific dates vary by month based on hop growth stages
meeting_point: Hukins Hops, Haffenden Farms, Bugglesden Rd, St Michaels, Tenterden TN30 6TG (at the taproom)
summary: A one-hour guided tour of the working Hukins Hops farm in Kent, walking the 18-foot-high hop gardens and visiting the hop picking and processing facility, with the taproom available afterwards.
description_md:
Kent is rich in hop growing and brewing history. Visit the stunning Hukins Hops estate and see how a modern hop farm combines with craft brewing to give you an experience to remember.

Step into the 18 foot high hop gardens and learn how hops are grown today to meet the dynamic craft beer market.

We'll visit the hop picking and processing facility to see how great British engineering combine with modern technology to pick 320,000 hop plants in just 30 days of harvest!

After the tour, why not grab a beer and food in the taproom at your leisure.
includes: Guided stroll through working hop farm
Tour of hop picking and processing facility

name: Birmingham Microbrewery Experience
schedule: Saturdays only (check availability for starting times and dates)
meeting_point: Rock and Roll Brewery, 19 Hall St, Birmingham B18 6BS
summary: A day visiting Birmingham brewery taprooms and craft beer venues with behind-the-scenes equipment tours at Rock and Roll Brewery and Burning Soul Brewery, finishing with beer, cheese and meat pairings at The Wolf.
description_md:
Visit several Birmingham brewery taprooms and craft beer venues in a day for behind the scenes tours of the equipment.

We start the day inside Rock and Roll Brewery where Mark and Lynn will take us on a tour of the equipment of this truly unique brewery. It's then onto the award winning Burning Soul Brewery to see the team for another look at the equipment and more tastings of the beers brewed on site. We'll then walk onto The Wolf for beer pairings of cheese and meats with even more beer tastings to round off the day.

name: Glasgow Beer Tasting
summary: A 60-minute tutored craft beer tasting session at Glasgow's iconic Platform venue, led by expert local guides through a selection of classic beer styles — ideal for corporate outings and stag and hen parties.
description_md: Join us for an unforgettable craft beer tasting experience at Glasgow's iconic Platform, operated by the renowned UK Brewery Tours. Whether you're organising a memorable corporate outing or looking for a unique twist on stag and hen parties, our Craft Beer Tasting Extravaganza offers an immersive journey into the world of beers. Delve into the rich tapestry of brewing with our expert local guides, who will lead you through a tutored tasting session featuring a selection of classic beer styles.
includes: Insightful storytelling on beer history and brewing processes

name: Dorset Brewery Tours: Badger Ales
meeting_point: The Brewery, Hall & Woodhouse, Blandford St. Mary, Dorset DT11 9LS
summary: A tour of the independent, family-owned Hall & Woodhouse (Badger) brewery in Dorset, with a flight of beers included; a Brewery Tour option at £17 and a Brewery Experience with expert tasting at £25.
description_md:
Wherever you're enjoying a tasty Badger beer, it's always special. But there's something even more wonderful about having one at the home of Badger beers – the independent, family-owned Hall & Woodhouse brewery in Dorset. The aroma of the hops. The taste of the malts. The unique inner workings. And hearing first-hand the craft, expertise and legendary stories behind our characterful beers. Enjoy a tour at Badger Brewery.

Two options are offered: Brewery Tours at £17 and the Brewery Experience at £25 (which adds an expert tasting of the award-winning beer collection). Both include a flight of beers and a tour of the state-of-the-art brewery installed in 2012, covering the brewery's 200-year journey.
includes: Flight of beers (included in both options)
Expert tasting of award-winning beer collection (Brewery Experience only)

name: Cardiff Beer Tasting Tour
meeting_point: Cardiff Castle, Castle Street, Cardiff CF10 3RB (just inside the South Gate entrance)
summary: A private group craft beer tour of Cardiff (minimum 10 people) visiting 3 brewery taprooms, starting with a meet-up inside Cardiff Castle and featuring independent Welsh craft beers with a behind-the-scenes brewery look.
description_md:
Discover the best that Cardiff has to offer at a number of different craft beer venues in the city. This is available as a private group tour for a minimum of 10 people.

Our Cardiff Craft Beer Tour allows guests to sample quality, independent Welsh craft beers at a selection of Cardiff's specialist craft beer bars and tap rooms including a local brewery. We sample different beer styles such as pale ales, IPAs and stouts. It's all about quality Welsh produce on this tour with beer from local suppliers. What could be better than a selection of quality independent craft beer?

This tour takes place inside 3 different Cardiff brewery taprooms and you'll enjoy beers at each stop. We gather within the walls of Cardiff's iconic city centre castle for meet-up and an introduction, before heading for a welcome drink at the city's newest brewery, a look behind the scenes at the brewery and an insight into how your beer is crafted. Your guide will be on hand to talk you through the carefully selected beers and explain how their ingredients and methods combine to the flavours that you'll enjoy.

name: Heist Brewery Tours
summary: A weekly one-hour tour of Heist Brew Co in Sheffield, seeing the brewing process behind the beers and enjoying 3 x 1/3 pints of Heist beers fresh from the tap.
description_md:
Heist started brewing from our old site in Clowne, Derbyshire in 2018, building a reputation for a wide variety of beers. The move to Sheffield was always on the cards and now allows us to expand operations with doubled fermentation capacity, an awesome new brewing team and plans to upgrade and replace the older 10HL brewkit in 2022.

Although our plans had been severely delayed due to the Covid-19 outbreak, we are back at it, brewing flat out to service the new taproom and our fantastic customers across the country.

Join the team on our weekly brewery tours, see the process behind the beer and enjoy 3x 1/3 of Heist beers fresh from tap! Runs every Friday 16:00-17:00.
includes: 3x 1/3 pints of Heist beers fresh from tap

name: Moorhouse's Brewery Tours
summary: A behind-the-scenes tour of Moorhouse's Brewery in Burnley with a pie and pea supper, arranged by prior appointment, with optional beer add-ons of 4 halves or 4 pints.
description_md:
Discover Moorhouse's Brewery on a tour behind the scenes. Visits are only arranged by prior appointment.

All bookings and pie choices must be confirmed and paid for 1 week prior to the event. If you are booking as a gift on behalf of someone please provide an additional email address within the message field so we can send event reminders.
includes: Optional: 4 halves of Moorhouse's beers (£6 extra)
Optional: 4 pints of Moorhouse's beers (£12 extra)
